ai.notes: The document is the 2025 Annual Report, printed Mar 23, 2026; fiscal_year is set to 2026 as instructed. The cover page reads 'Qisda' while the rest of the report is Global Unichip Corp., an apparent extraction artifact. The internal control statement refers to December 31, 2022, which is inconsistent with the reporting year. The MPW short-term initiative says it will 'lower customers' entry barriers', but the report does not target it at startups or small businesses, so it is scored as serving (level 1). Under the lower-level rule this was a close call between 1 and 2. Occupational safety, information security, PIP and ethics training are compliance training and are excluded. Directors' outside roles (TSMC Education and Culture Foundation, National Culture and Arts Foundation, Children Charity Association) are personal affiliations, not company activities. The ethics whistleblowing system offered in Chinese and English is too minor to score. Human rights policy details are referred to the 2024 ESG Report, but the human capital section has enough specific content to be sufficient.
